kind.description: new | existing. Informational — drive the UI from status, not this.

photos.description: In display order. The first one leads the listing.

reservation.description: Connected booking platforms. Empty until one is connected.

reviewNote.description: Why an admin sent it back. Non-null only after a send-back.

scanError.description: Plain sentence, safe to show. Non-null only while scan_failed.

social.description:
Authorised social accounts. Empty for an owner who connected none, which
is the common case — connecting is optional.

url.description: Safe to put straight into an . Unguessable rather than signed — the uuid in the object name is what keeps an unpublished photo private.

integrationId.description: Echoed back so the owner can check what they entered.

need.description:
Free-form: what the owner needs to hand before this step makes sense.
Shape is the platform's, not ours.

handle.description: What to show the owner so they recognise the account.

provider.description: instagram | tiktok. Facebook cannot be connected, only typed.

revoked.description:
The provider withdrew the grant; the connection needs redoing. The row is
kept so this can be said out loud rather than the account disappearing.

phoneMasked.description:
Masked to the country code and last four. Null means we have no number to
text, so this one cannot be verified at all.

establishmentType.description: A single value, not a list.

moments.description: Meal moments — brunch, late night, and so on.

perfectFor.description:
The UI's "Perfect for". Called known_for inside the AI extraction and
perfect_fors in the directory; this is the name on our wire.

reservationPlatforms.description: Free text read off the website. Not a connected integration.

apiKey.description: Some platforms are keyless and hand one back instead.

attemptsRemaining.description:
Advisory: the OTP service does not report how many tries are left, so
this counts down from a constant and the real limit lives over there.

resendAvailableAt.description:
The earliest the client may call POST /verifications again for this
place. Keep the resend button disabled until it passes.

status.description: HTTP status code as string per JSON:API spec
